verdict.rationale: Close documents an official MCP server at developer.close.com/mcp (confirmed by probe). It gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other tools no-code access to Close data, with scoped permissions (mcp.read, mcp.write_safe, mcp.write_destructive) and official support across the Claude ecosystem. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and detail on the exposed tool catalog and connection setup.
